LanguageData.TM_Bridge_SniperSingleOpening.label: single opening
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_SniperSingleOpening.descriptio: Hold position and keep sight of one hostile target while aiming. After 5 seconds of preparation, fire three single bullets at 120% weapon damage over 9 seconds. Range is limited to 45 cells or the weapon’s range, whichever is shorter. Take 20% more damage while aiming. Base cost: 60% stamina. Cooldown: two days. Interrupting preparation costs 6% stamina and starts a shorter cooldown.
